policy_basis: BTRC Telecommunications Network and Licensing Policy 2025 Clause 11.11(a)
evidence_basis: The policy requires energy-efficient low-emission and environmentally friendly technologies but does not establish common operator-level indicators targets baselines or reporting methods.
rule: If the policy requires energy efficiency but does not define common operator-level measurement indicators targets baselines or reporting methods identify a Measurement Gap.

indicator: Energy savings and energy reduction indicators
policy_basis: BTRC Telecommunications Network and Licensing Policy 2025 Clause 11.11(a)
evidence_basis: Operators report energy-efficiency practices using different levels and forms of quantitative evidence. Banglalink reports approximately 4 GWh of energy savings and a 1.1% reduction while comparable indicators are not sufficiently available for Grameenphone and Robi.
rule: If operators report energy-efficiency performance using different or insufficiently comparable indicators baselines or levels of detail identify a Comparability Gap.

policy_basis: BTRC Telecommunications Network and Licensing Policy 2025 Clause 11.11(b); Renewable Energy Policy 2025
evidence_basis: All three operators report renewable-energy adoption but use different measures and units including solar-powered sites kWp GWh GJ and percentage of network sites.
rule: If operators report renewable-energy adoption using different measures or units that prevent meaningful comparison identify a Comparability Gap.

policy_basis: BTRC Telecommunications Network and Licensing Policy 2025 Clause 11.12; Renewable Energy Policy 2025
evidence_basis: Large-scale renewable-energy procurement depends on supporting regulatory and contractual mechanisms and reported implementation challenges affect renewable-energy scaling.
rule: If renewable-energy procurement is constrained by unresolved supporting regulatory or contractual mechanisms identify an Implementation Gap.

policy_basis: BTRC Telecommunications Network and Licensing Policy 2025 Clause 11.11(d)
evidence_basis: Banglalink does not provide sufficient operator-level GHG data for direct comparison and the three operators disclose different levels of GHG information.
rule: If sufficient operator-level GHG information is unavailable to assess implementation or enable comparison identify a Disclosure Gap.

indicator: GHG emissions measures baselines and targets
policy_basis: BTRC Telecommunications Network and Licensing Policy 2025 Clause 11.11(d)
evidence_basis: Operators report different GHG measures baselines and levels of detail making direct comparison difficult.
rule: If operators use different GHG measures baselines or reporting levels that prevent meaningful comparison identify a Comparability Gap.

indicator: Operator-specific GHG reduction target and reported performance
policy_basis: BTRC Telecommunications Network and Licensing Policy 2025 Clause 11.11(d); operator-reported targets
evidence_basis: Grameenphone reported 231774 tCO2e of Scope 1 and 2 emissions in 2025 compared with a 2019 baseline of 216189 tCO2e and has a 2030 target to reduce Scope 1 and 2 emissions by 50%.
rule: If comparable operator-specific evidence shows reported GHG performance is not aligned with the operator's own stated reduction pathway or target identify a Performance Gap. Do not treat this alone as proof of policy non-compliance.

indicator: E-waste collection recycling and disposal quantities
policy_basis: BTRC Telecommunications Network and Licensing Policy 2025 Clause 11.11(c)
evidence_basis: Grameenphone reports 1163.94 tonnes of e-waste recycled while Banglalink does not provide sufficient operator-level quantitative e-waste data and Robi does not clearly separate telecom-specific e-waste from other waste.
rule: If sufficient operator-level quantitative information on e-waste collection recycling or disposal is unavailable identify a Disclosure Gap.

indicator: E-waste collection recycling and disposal reporting
policy_basis: BTRC Telecommunications Network and Licensing Policy 2025 Clause 11.11(c)
evidence_basis: Operators provide different levels of detail and do not consistently report comparable telecom-specific e-waste quantities.
rule: If operators report e-waste management using different scopes measures or levels of detail that prevent meaningful comparison identify a Comparability Gap.

indicator: Tower fibre radio-network and other infrastructure sharing
policy_basis: BTRC Telecommunications Network and Licensing Policy 2025 Clauses 5.3 7.2.8 7.7 and 13.6
evidence_basis: Policy supports active and passive infrastructure sharing but sufficient quantitative operator-level information is not available to measure the extent of sharing or its environmental benefits.
rule: If infrastructure sharing is supported by policy but comparable quantitative operator-level evidence is insufficient to assess its extent or environmental benefits identify an Evidence Gap and Disclosure Gap.

policy_basis: BTRC Telecommunications Network and Licensing Policy 2025 Clause 11.2.5
evidence_basis: The policy sets targets of 50% tower fiberization within 1.5 years and 80% within three years but sufficient operator-level data are unavailable to verify progress.
rule: If a policy sets a measurable tower-fiberization target but sufficient operator-level evidence is unavailable to verify progress identify an Evidence Gap rather than non-compliance.

indicator: Government and regulatory support for renewable-energy procurement
policy_basis: BTRC Telecommunications Network and Licensing Policy 2025 Clause 11.12
evidence_basis: Reported challenges in large-scale renewable-energy procurement indicate that government and regulatory support mechanisms can affect Green ICT implementation.
rule: If implementation of renewable-energy adoption is affected by limitations in government regulatory or procurement support mechanisms identify an Implementation Gap.

indicator: Diesel backup generation at disaster-prone tower sites
policy_basis: BTRC Telecommunications Network and Licensing Policy 2025 Clause 11.2.7
evidence_basis: The policy requires diesel generators at 25% of tower sites in disaster-prone areas to maintain network resilience while continued diesel use can increase fuel consumption and emissions.
rule: If a resilience requirement requires continued diesel backup use that can increase fuel consumption or emissions identify a Policy Tension between network resilience and carbon reduction.
